newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso shrugs off strikes, ends off a tad.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso shrugs off strikes, ends off a tad.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended slightly lower against the dollar at 1,075.45 in an interbank market that seemed to shrug off the start of a nationwide public workers' strike, dealers said.
The peso fell 0.95 against the dollar from Monday's close.
Traders said the session was abbreviated, however, as many dealers left early due to strike-related transportation problems.
"There were very few trades," one dealer said, noting that the strike had failed to have any real impact on prices.
Dealers reported 116 trades for a lackluster $48 million and said the peso held in a 1,074.30 to 1,076.00 range.
